register_converter_decorator: register a converter function for a source type using the BaseConverter register decorator
register_converter_method: register a converter callable for a source type by calling BaseConverter register as a method
convert_instance: convert an instance to the destination type using a registered converter via BaseConverter convert
lookup_converter: perform recursive lookup to find a registered converter for a given type or its base classes
make_int_box: convert a PyTorch tensor bounding box into a tuple of four integers
